_note: Cindercrag Quarry, levels 6-7: some rooms are the enemy. See docs/zones.md.

cc_road.name: The Quarry Road
cc_road.description: A road of crushed stone climbing east to the quarry. Smoke hangs over it.

cc_gate.name: The Quarry Gate
cc_gate.description: The foreman's camp behind a barricade of carts. A fire, tents, and tired quarrymen.

features.barricade: Scorched where the Slagborn threw fire at it.
features.caravan: A big wagon with an awning, loading for the Ash Road east.

cc_slagrun.name: The Slag Run
cc_slagrun.description: A long trench of slag heaps, warm underfoot. Little soot-black figures watch from the heaps.

cc_kilns.name: The Old Kilns
cc_kilns.description: Beehive kilns, some still glowing. The Slagborn live in them.

cc_pit.name: The Ogre's Pit
cc_pit.description: A pit gouged out of the rock, strewn with crushed carts. Brakka lives here.

cc_tip.name: The Slag Tip
cc_tip.description: The edge of the tip, where the slag goes over. A tunnel leads down into the galleries.

features.tunnel: Steam rolls out of it in hot gusts.

cc_gallery.name: The Steam Gallery
cc_gallery.description: A long gallery where vents in the floor blast scalding steam. Don't stop.

trap.name: a steam vent
trap.hit: A vent blasts scalding steam all over you.
trap.avoid: You time the vents and dart between them.
trap.sprung: {actor} is caught in a blast of steam!

sign.name: steam
sign.text: Steam rolls out of the tunnel in gusts, regular as breathing. Down there, the vents go off one after another.

cc_vents.name: The Vent Hall
cc_vents.description: A hall of vents, hissing in turn. The far gallery is beyond.

features.vents: They blow in a rhythm, if you can catch it.

trap.name: the vent hall's vents
trap.hit: Two vents go off at once, and you're in the middle.
trap.avoid: You read their rhythm and slip through.
trap.sprung: {actor} vanishes in a cloud of steam!

sign.name: hiss
sign.text: The hall ahead hisses like a kettle. Cross it quickly, or carefully, or both.

cc_survey.name: The Far Gallery
cc_survey.description: A dead-end gallery, quiet after the vents. A surveyor's camp, long abandoned.

features.camp: A bedroll, a dead lamp, and a case of instruments.

cc_deepface.name: The Deep Face
cc_deepface.description: The deepest face of the quarry. A shaft, with a rusted cage, goes down into the dark.

features.shaft: The old miners' shaft. It goes a long way down. The air from it smells bad.

survey_case.name: survey case
survey_case.description: A brass-cornered case of surveying instruments, warm from the steam.

dunstan.name: Foreman Dunstan
dunstan.label: Foreman
dunstan.description: a broad man with a burned beard and a clipboard
dunstan.details: A broad man with a burned beard and a clipboard.

topics.work: The Slagborn took my quarry. Ask me about the survey, the raiders, or Brakka.

survey.text: My surveyor went into the Steam Galleries for the deep-face survey and never came out. The case is in the far gallery. Don't fight the vents: get through them.

raiders.text: Six of the little soot-devils, and the rest might think twice. Mind the fire-pots: dodge them.

brakka.text: An ogre. Throws boulders. He's in a pit north of the kilns, and you don't have to go near him. If you do, block the boulders, and good luck.

topics.caravan: The Ash Road caravan goes east from here, to the Emberwaste. Saffa runs it. You'd want a reason to go.
topics.shaft: The old shaft at the Deep Face goes down into the Underdeep. The air down there kills. Don't.

quarry_maul.name: Quarry Maul
quarry_maul.perfect_hit: {actor} brings the maul down on {target} perfectly!
quarry_maul.description: A quarryman's maul, rebalanced for heads instead of stone. It likes the heat.

quarry_cap.name: Quarryman's Cap
quarry_cap.description: A padded leather-and-felt cap that has stopped a few falling rocks. +1 Vigor.

get.goal: Get through the Steam Galleries (from the Slag Tip) to the far gallery: GET CASE.

back.goal: Bring it back to Foreman Dunstan: USE CASE ON DUNSTAN.

effects.text: Dunstan opens it, and goes quiet. "His notes. He went down the shaft. Here: you've earned a proper tool."

kill.goal: Kill six Slagborn on the Slag Run and in the kilns.

back.goal: Tell Dunstan: ASK DUNSTAN ABOUT RAIDERS.

kill.goal: Kill Brakka, in his pit north of the kilns. Block the boulders.

back.goal: Tell Dunstan: ASK DUNSTAN ABOUT BRAKKA.
